jobs.title: Business Systems Analyst
jobs.description:
Haugland Group, a privately owned Long Island, New York-based civil infrastructure and energy construction company, has an immediate opportunity for an experienced Business Systems Analyst to join our team.

The Business Systems Analyst acts as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring that application solutions meet operational needs and deliver measurable value. They focus on requirements gathering, process analysis, documentation, and testing, supporting the Director in executing the applications roadmap.

At Haugland, we understand that pushing the boundaries of what has been done is essential to develop the infrastructure of tomorrow. The journey won’t be simple, but what gets us there is. At Haugland Group, Our Word is Our Way. We are leaders in building what’s next because we see the path to get there, and we’re setting a new standard of exceptional along the way.

Let’s build together!

**Key Functions:**

* Conduct stakeholder interviews, workshops, and observations across Estimating, Operations, Finance, HR, and Safety to identify business needs, document processes, pain points, improvement opportunities, and develop functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Create current-state and future-state process maps for job cost tracking, certified payroll, change order management, and RFI/submittal workflows, identifying inefficiencies and recommending automation or system enhancements.
* Support system selection, upgrades, fit-gap analysis, application configuration validation with vendors and internal teams, and data migration planning, including mapping, cleansing, and validation.
* Develop UAT test plans and scripts, coordinate testing cycles, log defects, verify fixes, and validate system integrations.
* Prepare functional specifications, process guides, SOPs, training materials, and application knowledge bases while assisting with end-user training.
* Define dashboard and KPI reporting requirements and validate data accuracy in cost reports, WIP schedules, and compliance reports.
* Along with the PM team and post-go-live team, gather post-implementation feedback, monitor system usage and adoption metrics, and recommend improvements or new features based on user feedback and industry best practices.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Strong understanding of construction workflows, including estimating, project management, payroll, and compliance.
* Familiarity with ERP systems, project management platforms, and estimating tools such as Viewpoint, Procore, and HCSS.
* Proficiency in process modeling tools (Visio, Lucidchart) and reporting tools (Power BI, Crystal Reports).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Exceptional documentation skills with the ability to consistently and accurately capture processes, requirements, workflows, and decisions and translate them into detailed, easy-to-follow SOPs and process documentation.
* Ability to collaborate with IT, vendors, and functional department leads across Estimating, Finance, and Operations.

**Why Haugland?**

**Compensation range for this role is $140-165k.**

At Haugland Group, our benefits are designed to convey company culture and values which has employees at its forefront.

* Excellent benefits package including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, Health Savings Account (HSA), short/long-term disability, and life insurance
* 401k with 5% employer match
* Employer funded Dependent Care FSA
* Potential for annual performance-based raise
* Paid Time Off
* Paid company observed holidays
* Educational and professional advancement opportunities
* Frequent company-sponsored events
* Relaxed, friendly office
* Fast-paced, exciting environment

Haugland Group LLC and its operating divisions, affiliates, related entities, and subsidiaries (collectively, “the Company”) do not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or employment agencies. Unsolicited referrals and resumes are considered property of the Company and therefore, the Company will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited referral. Only upon the Company’s written request may preferred vendors may be invited to refer talent for specific open positions. In these cases, a fully executed agreement with the Company must be in place and current.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Data Science Analyst - Agentic AI Developer
jobs.description:
Welcome to the intersection of energy and home services. At NRG, we’re all about propelling the next generation of leaders forward. We are driven by our passion to create a smarter, cleaner and more connected future. We deliver innovative solutions that make our customers’ lives easier—helping them power, protect, and intelligently manage their homes and businesses. To do this, we need creative and talented people to join our company.

We offer a dynamic work environment and a unified and inclusive culture. NRG fosters a strong sense of belonging that leads to better collaboration and business performance. Our company programs are designed to help employees develop the skills they need for success now and in the future. In everything we do, we aim to champion our employees and bring value to our customers, investors and society.

More information is available at www.nrg.com. Connect with NRG on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and X.

**Job Summary:**
----------------

NRG Energy is seeking a Data Science Analyst – Agentic AI Developer to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions that improve decision-making, automate business processes, and generate actionable insights across the organization. This role combines data science, machine learning, software engineering, and agentic AI development to solve complex business challenges in the energy industry. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across the full AI lifecycle—from data acquisition and model development to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement—and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

**Essential Duties/Responsibilities:**
--------------------------------------

* Collect, clean, integrate, and preprocess large structured and unstructured datasets to support advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI applications.
* Design, develop, deploy, and optimize machine learning models for forecasting, predictive analytics, anomaly detection, recommendation systems, classification, and operational optimization.
* Build AI-powered applications using large language models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, APIs, and workflow automation to improve productivity and streamline business processes.
* Rapidly prototype, test, and deploy scalable AI solutions, translating ambiguous business challenges into practical, production-ready applications.
* Develop scalable data pipelines, reusable software components, APIs, and AI workflows that integrate enterprise data sources and operational systems.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, software engineers, data engineers, analysts, and subject matter experts to integrate AI capabilities into business workflows.
* Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, generate actionable insights, and communicate findings through dashboards, reports, and data visualizations for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Monitor, evaluate, and continuously improve AI models and applications to ensure accuracy, scalability, reliability, governance, and responsible AI practices.
* Stay current with emerging AI, machine learning, and data science technologies, evaluating opportunities to drive innovation and business value.

**Working Conditions:**
-----------------------

* Fully in-office position based in Houston, TX or Princeton, NJ, with flexibility to work outside normal business hours as needed to support critical business operations and project milestones.

**Minimum Requirements:**
-------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Quantitative Finance, or a related quantitative discipline, completed or expected to be completed by December 2026; Master’s degree preferred.
* Zero or more years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, AI application development, or advanced analytics.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, or similar orchestration frameworks; NLP, Generative AI, Computer Vision, Spark, Databricks, MLflow, Kubernetes, time-series forecasting, energy markets, or cloud-native AI services (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) is highly desirable
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience processing large datasets and developing production-quality software.
* Experience with machine learning frameworks such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost, or similar technologies.
* Experience developing AI applications using LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, AI agent frameworks, vector databases, REST APIs, and modern software development tools (Git, Docker).
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Plotly, or Matplotlib), and building scalable data pipelines.
* Strong understanding of statistics, feature engineering, model evaluation, and MLOps fundamentals.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple priorities, collaborate across multidisciplinary teams, and deliver high-quality AI solutions with professionalism, integrity, and a commitment to continuous learning.

jobs.title: Security & Network Analyst II
jobs.description:
**Security & Network Analyst II**
---------------------------------

Under intermediate supervision, the Security & Network Analyst II supports cybersecurity operations by monitoring security events, identifying potential threats, and assisting with incident response activities. This role supports threat detection and incident response efforts, collaborates with security engineers and analysts to improve security controls, and contributes to threat hunting and detection tuning initiatives. The Security Analyst II applies developing expertise to identify risks, strengthen defenses, and enhance the organization's overall security posture.

**Key Responsibilities & Essential Functions**
----------------------------------------------

* Support security and network operations activities with a focus on threat detection, cyber defense, incident response, and maintaining the security and availability of enterprise systems.
* Monitor, investigate, and resolve alerts from SIEM, EDR/XDR, IDS/IPS, firewall, vulnerability management, identity, cloud security, and network monitoring platforms.
* Analyze logs, endpoint telemetry, authentication records, firewall events, DNS activity, proxy logs, packet captures, and network flow data to identify security threats, operational issues, and performance concerns.
* Investigate and manage assigned tickets, including suspicious activity reports, security alerts, vulnerability findings, VPN issues, access requests, connectivity problems, and service interruptions.
* Conduct incident response activities, including event analysis, scoping, evidence collection, documentation, containment support, escalation, and post-incident follow-up in accordance with established procedures.
* Troubleshoot issues involving DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, firewall policies, VPN connectivity, wireless networks, identity services, endpoints, and application access.
* Evaluate false positives, benign activity, policy violations, operational issues, and security incidents requiring escalation or response.
* Escalate complex technical issues to Security Engineering, Network Engineering, Infrastructure, or application support teams with appropriate documentation, supporting evidence, and impact assessments.
* Assist with identifying recurring issues, monitoring gaps, alert quality concerns, and process improvement opportunities; recommend enhancements to strengthen operational effectiveness and security visibility.
* Support vulnerability management activities by validating findings, assessing exposure, assisting with remediation prioritization, and tracking resolution efforts.
* Assist with firewall rule reviews, VPN troubleshooting, network segmentation validation, access control issues, implementation testing, and post-change monitoring with minimal oversight.
* Collaborate with Security Engineering, Network Engineering, Infrastructure, and application teams to improve security monitoring, detection capabilities, operational procedures, and incident response processes.
* Create and maintain investigation notes, knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, operational procedures, and incident documentation with minimal oversight.
* Provide guidance and knowledge sharing to less experienced analysts and contribute to team training initiatives when needed.
* Participate in security projects, technology implementations, and continuous improvement efforts to enhance cybersecurity and network operations capabilities.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred. A combination of education and experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Three or more years of experience in technology, cybersecurity operations, network operations, infrastructure support, incident response, or a closely related technical role.
* Intermediate knowledge related to SOC, NOC, security operations, network operations, managed security, enterprise infrastructure, or hybrid security/network operations environment preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently on complex tickets, alerts, incidents, and troubleshooting tasks with limited supervision and strong judgment on when to escalate.
* Intermediate Knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, VPNs, firewalls, proxy services, wireless networking, endpoint security, identity and access management, and common enterprise security controls.
* Intermediate experience using several of the following tools preferred: SIEM (e.g., Splunk), EDR/XDR (e.g., Microsoft Defender, Cortex XDR), firewall management platforms (e.g., Palo Alto Panorama/PA firewalls, Cisco firewalls), vulnerability scanners (e.g., Tenable), email/phishing security tools (e.g., PhishER), IDS/IPS, packet capture tools, network monitoring systems, log analysis platforms, ITSM/ticketing systems, and cloud security or infrastructure monitoring tools.
* Experience to analyze endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and application telemetry to identify anomalous activity, unauthorized access, malware behavior, phishing, credential abuse, lateral movement, vulnerability exploitation, or service degradation.
* Ability to perform structured troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across security, network, endpoint, identity, and application layers.
* Experience supporting incident response activities such as alert validation, event correlation, impact assessment, containment coordination, evidence collection, timeline development, and post-incident documentation.
* Experience reviewing or supporting firewall policies, VPN access, network segmentation, remote access technologies, and secure connectivity workflows preferred.
* Understanding of frameworks and models such as NIST NICE, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-53, CIS Controls, MITRE ATT&CK, or similar operational security frameworks preferred.
* Experience supporting hybrid cloud or SaaS environment

jobs.title: In-House Accountant / Financial Analyst – Restaurant Group
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented **In-House Accountant / Financial Analyst** to manage the financial operations of our growing restaurant group, currently operating four restaurants.

The ideal candidate will have strong accounting and financial analysis skills, preferably with experience in the restaurant or hospitality industry.

We are looking for someone who can do more than bookkeeping. **You must be able to analyze financial data, identify discrepancies, explain financial results, and help management make informed business decisions.**

Key Responsibilities

* Manage daily bookkeeping and accounting operations for four restaurants.
* Monitor and analyze sales, expenses, profitability, and cash flow.
* Reconcile transactions, deposits, and payments from Toast POS and third-party delivery platforms, including Uber Eats.
* Verify processing fees, commissions, deductions, and payouts to ensure accuracy.
* Manage vendor invoices, payments, and accounts payable.
* Compare supplier pricing and identify opportunities to reduce costs.
* Prepare and review profit and loss (P&L) statements and other financial reports.
* Monitor food costs, labor costs, and operating expenses.
* Identify financial discrepancies and investigate their causes.
* Prepare clear financial summaries and recommendations for management.
* Maintain accurate financial records across all four restaurant locations.
* Coordinate with external accountants and payroll providers when necessary.

Requirements

* Previous professional experience in accounting, bookkeeping, or financial management.
* Strong financial analysis and reconciliation skills.
* **Experience with Toast POS is strongly preferred.**
* Familiarity with Uber Eats and other restaurant delivery platforms is highly preferred.
* Experience managing financial operations for multiple business locations is a plus.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel and accounting software.
* Ability to independently identify errors and explain financial results.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Previous experience in the restaurant or hospitality industry is highly preferred.

What We're Looking For

We need someone who understands the numbers behind the business.

You should be comfortable answering questions such as:

* Where is the restaurant spending the most money?
* Are Toast and Uber Eats paying us the correct amounts?
* Are delivery platform fees and deductions accurate?
* Are our food and labor costs within budget?
* Which suppliers offer better prices?
* What can we improve to increase profitability?

**This is not simply a data-entry position.** We need an experienced professional who can take ownership of our financial reporting and provide meaningful insights to management.

Compensation & Schedule

* **Salary:** $60,000 per year ($5,000 per month)
* **Schedule:** Monday through Friday, 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM
* **Work Location:** On-site in New Jersey
* **Employment Type:** Full-Time

How to Apply

Please submit your resume detailing your accounting experience, particularly any experience with restaurant operations, Toast POS, Uber Eats, financial reporting, and multi-location businesses.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Pay: $5,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Asset Management Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Solar Landscape is the nation’s leading distributed energy infrastructure company, transforming commercial real estate into a source of new power by deploying solar and storage at scale. Partnering with more than 170+ commercial real estate owners, the company develops, builds, owns, and operates distributed energy projects that deliver new capacity to the grid in as little as 12 months while generating long-term income for commercial and industrial property owners.

Proven by our performance, backed by institutional capital, and trusted by the biggest names in commercial real estate, we’re building the future of energy, and it shows:

* Recognized by the Financial Times as one of the fastest-growing companies in the U.S. in 2025
* Named to the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies
* Ranked the #1 commercial rooftop solar developer by Solar Power World in both 2025 and 2026

That doesn’t happen without a team of smart, driven, and down-to-earth people who are serious about doing excellent work—and fun to work with. At Solar Landscape, you’ll be challenged, trusted with responsibility, and surrounded by people who thrive in our fast-paced environment. Career growth here isn’t limited by title or a rigid path: people who take ownership and deliver are given opportunities to stretch, lead, and make an impact. Along the way, you’ll be supported by great benefits, professional development, and a culture that values authenticity, collaboration, and accountability.

Across our headquarters in Asbury Park, New Jersey and our offices in New York City, Chicago, and Baltimore, Solar Landscape employees are building something that matters, deploying critical energy infrastructure that creates long-term value for communities, property owners, and the grid. Come join us.

**About The Role**

### **Responsibilities**

* Monitor Solar Landscape solar power plants daily, comparing output to expected and working to ensure all systems are performing at or above forecasted production.
* Identify and report system underperformance and alerts to Asset Managers.
* Investigate issues and initiate actions to improve portfolio performance by conducting preliminary diagnostics and escalating appropriately.
* Track all system alerts and work under the direction of the Asset Manager to create work orders and coordinate support with the O&M team.
* Optimize monitoring platforms to improve capabilities and response time.
* Prepare system reports for internal and external reporting.
* Optimize and improve reporting tools and templates.
* Support monthly/quarterly/annual maintenance activities and reports.
* Support warranty claims process, including processing claims and tracking progress.
* Assist in onboarding new systems into the monitoring platform as projects transition from construction to operations.
* Maintain organized documentation and assist in tracking performance trends across the portfolio.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or 4+ years of relevant professional experience.
* B.S. in STEM field preferred.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to review and interpret data sets.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Advanced computer skills especially in Excel (Microsoft Office).
* Ability to read and interpret project and contract specifications.
* Understanding of electrical and civil engineering drawings.
* Ability to work independently in a team-oriented and fast-paced environment.
* Ability to undertake complex tasks.
* Project oriented with a goal to complete assignments on time.
* Organizational and process orientation skills to clearly maintain project documentation, correspondence, and related files.

**Benefits and Perks**

We offer competitive compensation and benefits designed to support you inside and outside of work:

* Training / Professional development opportunities
* 401(k) with 4% company match
* Summer Fridays
* Flexible remote/hybrid work options
* Paid parental leave
* Team lunches, events, and stocked kitchens
* Modern, collaborative office spaces in Asbury Park, New York City, Boston, Chicago, and Baltimore
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Company-paid life and long-term disability insurance

If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact us at hr@solarlandscape.com.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**JOB TITLE**: Data Analyst

**REPORTS TO**: Director of Data Strategy & Reporting

**DEPARTMENT:** Data Strategy & Reporting

**HOURS**: 40 Hours Monday – Friday 9:00a – 5:00p

**FLSA STATUS**: Exempt

**JOB TYPE:** Full-Time

**RATE**: $90k – 125k

**About Healthix**  
Healthix is the largest public health information exchange (HIE) in New York State, securely connecting thousands of healthcare providers, hospitals, health plans, and community organizations to improve the quality, safety, and efficiency of care. Through the secure exchange of health information, Healthix helps ensure that clinicians, care teams, and public health partners have access to the data they need to make informed decisions and deliver better outcomes for the communities they serve.

As part of our ongoing **organizational transformation**, Healthix is expanding its focus beyond data exchange to making health information more actionable and impactful for healthcare providers, community partners, and public health initiatives. This transformation reflects our commitment to strengthening community partnerships, improving health equity, and supporting innovative approaches that connect healthcare with community-based services.

Through initiatives such as **Healthix Connects**, our internal volunteer and community engagement program, we are deepening our relationships with local organizations and creating opportunities for our team to actively support healthier, safer communities.

Joining Healthix means becoming part of a mission-driven organization that is shaping the future of health information sharing while building stronger connections between healthcare systems and the communities they serve.

**THE ROLE:**  
The Data Analyst provides the foundation for analytics, namely the collection, quality assurance and availability of data. This IT role requires a significant set of technical skills, including a deep knowledge of SQL, SQL database design and multiple programming languages as well as communication skills to understand what data and analysis the healthcare analysts want to gain from Healthix data stores. They are responsible for the maintenance, improvement, cleansing and manipulation of data in the organization’s operational and analytics databases. The Data Analyst works with team members to define and build data pipelines to orchestrate the movement, transformation, validation, and loading of data from the source to the final destination – data stores defined and implemented based on system requirements and data consumer requirements.

Typical tasks performed include working with the data architect on data warehouse design, ensuring data loads quickly, is easily accessible and rapidly comprehensible for analysts/users; extract, transform, and load (ETL) processing; performing thorough testing and validation in order to support the accuracy of data transformations and data verification to ensure correctness and that data is generally reliable for downstream consumption; data bounds checking and database tuning.

The Data Analyst strives to ensure proper data governance and quality for the Data Strategy team and the entire organization. They analyze complex data elements and systems, data flow, dependencies, and relationships to contribute to conceptual physical and logical data models. They work collaboratively within the Data Strategy team, providing support for their data centric needs. The candidate has strong working and conceptual knowledge of database queries multidimensional query and index tuning, monitoring, disaster recovery, backup, automated testing, automated schema migration, and continuous deployment.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Enhance and streamline data and pipeline architecture to improve data flow and collection.
* Partner with software developers, database architects, and data analysts to support data initiatives and ensure reliable data delivery.
* Independently address the data requirements of multiple teams, systems, and products.
* Refine or redesign Healthix’s data architecture to enable next‑generation products and data capabilities.
* Build and maintain scalable data pipelines and reporting solutions to support growing data volumes, performance and complex queries across Databricks, MS SQL Server, and InterSystems HealthShare.
* Work with Data Strategy and Business teams to improve data models and increase data accessibility for business intelligence.
* Implement monitoring processes to safeguard data quality, accuracy, and availability for key stakeholders.
* Develop queries, support reporting needs, and tailor reporting solutions to enable data‑driven decision‑making.
* Develop and execute unit and data validation tests while maintaining accurate documentation, perform data analysis to troubleshoot issues, support feasibility assessments, evaluate health outcomes, and resolve data‑related problems.
* Provide general reporting and project support across the organization.
* Ensure reporting meets standards for reliability, accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
* Support the development, ETL processes, and maintenance of company data assets and data models, design data integrations and data quality frameworks.
* Evaluate open‑source and vendor data‑lineage tools and contribute to long‑term data platform architecture planning across IT and Business teams.
* Assist in developing an integrated data warehouse to provide a comprehensive healthcare dataset.

 **Requirements**

**QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS and COMPETENCIES:**

  

* 5+ years of experience in a Data Analyst role, with a graduate degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Healthcare Informatics, Informatics, Information Systems, or a related field. IBM Certified Data Engineer or Google Certified Professional is preferred.
* Experience with healthcare data, including HL7, CCDAs, MS SQL Server, Databricks, Tableau, InterSystems HealthShare, and Cache databases.
* Advanced SQL knowledge and experience with relational datab

**About Children’s Specialized ABA** Children’s Specialized ABA is part of the Children’s Specialized Hospital Autism Center of Excellence. We serve children with ASD by combining clinical innovation, whole-child care, and personalized therapy.? At Children’s Specialized ABA, we envision a future where every child diagnosed with autism has access to innovative and compassionate care, empowering them to thrive and reach their full potential. jobs.title: Research Analyst - Enterprise Tech
jobs.description:
Enterprise technology is our largest and fastest-moving area of coverage, and demand for our research there is growing faster than we can produce it. That gap is why this role exists. You’ll join our Enterprise Tech team and cover software, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, data & AI, and IT services. You’ll write the research investors and corporate strategy teams use to judge where enterprise IT budgets are going, which vendors are winning and losing, and how fast AI is moving from pilots into production spend.

You’ll learn the sector from two sources: the domain expert who leads it, and the thousands of transcripts we collect from CIOs, CISOs, IT decision-makers, and other senior operators who buy and deploy enterprise technology. Institutions pay for that data to get up to speed on the space, and you’ll be analyzing it from day one. We’re hiring for analytical ability, writing quality, and speed of learning. Over time, you’ll build real depth and rigor, and you’ll own sub-sectors of your own.

**What the day-to-day looks like**

* Use our proprietary datasets to build company and market analyses across enterprise tech: application software, infrastructure and hyperscalers, security, data platforms, AI/LLM vendors, and IT services. You’ll work under the sector lead at first and own more of the coverage over time.
* Track the signals that drive the sector, including IT budget intentions, vendor consolidation and displacement, seat and consumption trends, pricing and renewal dynamics, and AI adoption and spend. Turn them into quantified, time-series views of who is gaining share and why.
* Turn data collection studies into client-ready outputs, such as quantified findings, charts, vendor scorecards, and written takeaways that investors can use ahead of earnings and corporate teams can use in planning.
* Build forward-looking analyses on emerging themes, such as agentic AI, security platformization, cloud optimization cycles, and the effect of AI on seat-based software models, and form a view before the market does.
* Write for our newsletter and client communications so that Qualitate is a go-to voice on enterprise tech.
* Support client and prospect conversations through calls, webinars, and events, and learn to lead them over time.
* Shape how we study enterprise tech: design survey and interview frameworks for buyer behavior, and partner with product and engineering to keep our methodology best-in-class.
* Grow into a coverage area of your own within enterprise tech. We’ll help you find the space where your judgment compounds fastest.

**Who This Role Is For**

* 1–3 years of professional experience in data-driven research, such as equity research, financial analysis, market research, and/or consulting. Exposure to software, internet, semiconductors, or IT services coverage is a strong plus but not required.
* Familiarity with enterprise software economics (ARR, net revenue retention, consumption vs. seat-based pricing, sales cycles), or the ability to pick it up quickly.
* An understanding of the fundamental research workflow, from how funds source ideas and build conviction through primary research to how they size positions and manage risk, or an eagerness to learn it quickly.
* Real curiosity about how enterprises buy and adopt technology. You should enjoy following the full stack, from infrastructure to applications, and be able to reach a credible working knowledge of a new category quickly.
* Clear communication. Long-form and short-form writing skills are required. You must be able to synthesize data into digestible, forward-looking insights, and you should be comfortable presenting your work to investors and strategy clients.
* Heavy experimentation with AI. You test and refine AI tools and agents as they ship, build them into your daily workflows, automate pieces of your own job to raise your productivity, and share what you learn with your team. In this coverage area, that hands-on experience doubles as sector insight.

**What Sets You Apart**

* **You learn and iterate quickly.** For this role, this is the single most important thing. You’ll work alongside accomplished professionals across research, product, and engineering. Pick up what they know and put it to use, and teach them what you know that they don’t.
* **A strong sense of ownership.** This is not just a supporting seat. You’ll be handed more scope than your years of experience would suggest. We expect you to take work from question to published output rather than wait to be assigned the next step.
* **An analytical mind.** You get excited about diving into a large semi-structured dataset to find key inflections and generate new ideas. You’re proficient at managing and analyzing large datasets, and SQL experience is strongly preferred.
* **You use AI for both speed and rigor.** You use AI to get up to speed on a space faster and to go deeper than you otherwise could: pressure-testing ideas, automating the analyses you never had time for, and expanding what one analyst can rigorously cover. In a sector as broad and fast-moving as enterprise tech, that leverage is what makes real depth possible.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Base salary: $130k–$170k+
* Bonus: Variable, based on goals achieved at the company, team, and individual levels
* Equity: Meaningful early-stage grant with upside tied to company growth
* Benefits: Health coverage, flexible PTO, paid holidays
* Location: Full-time, in-person in New York City

**What to expect working at Qualitate**

* **Excellence.** You’ll be held accountable to an exceptionally high bar for quality and impact.
* **High velocity.** A fast-paced environment for growth, decision-making, and time to impact.
* **High agency.** Ownership over how you work, not just what you work on. We hire people we trust to figure it out.
* **A builder’s mindset.** You’ll create the processes, playbooks, and systems that define how this company scales.
* **Shared ambition.** A small, earl

jobs.title: Security Analyst
jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Success Academy! Running a large, fast-growing, and high-performing network of public charter schools takes a village - families, children, teachers, staff and faculty, advocates, and supporters alike. We are growing fast in New York and expanding to Florida, and we would love to welcome you to our community! We work tirelessly every day to ensure children have access to a fun, rigorous, whole-child education regardless of zip code or economic status. When you join SA, you play a part in giving every student who walks through our doors a fair shot at reaching his or her potential.

**About the Role**

Success Academy is growing rapidly and security is at the forefront of enabling that growth. We are seeking a Security Analyst to join our Information Security & Privacy team. This individual will play a critical role in building, strengthening, and operationalizing our security programs. This is a unique opportunity to make an immediate and lasting impact, addressing the unique needs of a K-12 school environment.

  

The Security Analyst will be hands-on across multiple domains, including security operations, endpoint protection, cloud security, data loss prevention, compliance, and privacy, and partner closely with the Technology Operations team on security change management across the organization.

  

This role reports into the head of Security & Privacy and sits within the Technology department. The Technology team manages a modern technology environment built around cloud and SaaS based applications, operates networking and in-school technologies across 57 school locations, and supports managed devices used by over 3,000 employees and over 20,000 students. This position will be based in the network office (3-days a week onsite) in Manhattan (10005).

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Incident Response: use our SIEM to identify vulnerabilities, investigate alerts, and lead incident response & remediation efforts
* Email Security: Support existing efforts to build email compliance and DLP rules, and take proactive measures against advanced phishing techniques
* Security Operations: Partner with IT, engineering, and business stakeholders to ensure security is integrated into workflows across the organization
* Program Building: Lead implementation of scalable security processes across incident response, access management, vulnerability management, and DLP
* Cloud Security: Support security for AWS and GCP environments, working closely with cloud engineering teams to resolve vulnerabilities
* Security Tooling: Stay ahead of emerging threats and security trends, recommend and vet new tools as appropriate

  

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of professional experience in information security roles within technology-driven organizations
* Strong hands-on experience with security incident response workflows using a SIEM
* Experience with Crowdstrike Falcon or similar endpoint security platforms
* Expertise in Google Workspace security administration (Gmail rules, DLP, monitoring)
* Expertise in advanced email security platforms (Sublime, Mimecast, Proofpoint, Abnormal, etc.)
* Expertise with identity access management platforms (Okta)
* Knowledgeable in AWS and GCP infrastructure implementation, security controls, IAM, and monitoring, as well as Wiz
* Familiarity with security frameworks and privacy regulations (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FERPA)
* Ability to work hybrid onsite at Manhattan (10005) headquarters Tuesday through Thursday

  

**Competencies**

* Meticulous and tenacious mindset in identifying and resolving security risks
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to convey security concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

  

**Compensation, Benefits, & Perks**

At Success Academy, we invest boldly in our Network team with a comprehensive package designed to support your health, financial future, and overall well-being:

* **Day-One Health & Wellness:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting your first day (SA covers 82% of our core medical plan), plus a free One Medical membership and confidential mental health support via EAP/Talkspace.
* **Financial Security:** 403(b) retirement plan with a 3% employer match, up to $2,400/year in employer HSA contributions, employer-paid life/disability insurance, and Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) eligibility.
* **Time to Recharge:** Generous paid time off, paid holidays, and paid parental leave.
* **Perks & Stipends:** A $50/month cellphone stipend ($600/year), pre-tax commuter benefits, backup family care, and performance-based earning incentives.

This is a hybrid position based in our NYC Financial District office, requiring on-site work Tuesday through Thursday and remote work on Monday and Friday.

jobs.title: Data Analyst – Ticket Resale & Pricing
jobs.description:
Who is StubWorld?

StubWorld is a leading ticket resale, distribution and analytics business serving pro sports teams and live entertainment partners nationwide. We manage ticket inventory in real time across multiple sales channels, using market data and pricing strategy to maximize value for every event — from regular season games to playoff runs. If you love sports and want a job where market movement, player news, and ticket demand actually matter to your paycheck, this is it.

What are we looking for?

We're expanding our pricing team and looking for a Pricing Analyst who will work closely with ownership, analyze marketplace data, implement pricing strategy, and own weekend event coverage. This is a long-term role with real growth potential — StubWorld is one of several growing businesses under our umbrella, and the right person will have the opportunity to take on more responsibility across other projects as they prove themselves, not just sit still in one lane.

What would you do?

Manage and price ticket inventory across multiple sales channels.

Analyze historical sales, secondary market data, and industry trends to set and adjust pricing in real time.

Track sales and market movement on both primary and secondary markets, and report findings to ownership.

Roll out price changes across channels as market conditions shift — sometimes hour to hour on game day.

Build and maintain pricing models and recommendations.

Own Friday evening and Saturday event-day pricing and inventory coverage (see schedule below) — this is core to the role, not overtime.

Use AI and modern data tools (not just spreadsheets) to speed up pricing analysis, trend-spotting, and reporting — we want someone who wants to build this skill, not just run static Excel models.

Grow into additional responsibilities across our other business ventures as you prove yourself.

Schedule:

Tuesday–Thursday: standard business hours, in office

Friday: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM (covers Friday night event pricing)

Saturday: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM (covers Saturday event pricing)

Sunday and Monday: permanent days off

Weekend coverage (Fri/Sat) is a fixed, ongoing part of this role tied to live event schedules — not occasional.

What do you bring?

Strong analytical skills and comfort interpreting large datasets.

Working knowledge of AI-assisted tools for data analysis and reporting (ChatGPT, Claude, Excel/Sheets with AI add-ins, etc.) — we'd rather train someone curious about this than someone stuck in pure-manual Excel habits.

Excellent communicator, able to report findings clearly to ownership.

Reliable, highly detail-oriented, able to manage multiple priorities under deadline.

Genuine enthusiasm for sports and live entertainment markets.

Comfortable working some night and weekend hours as a fixed part of the schedule above.

Required: High school diploma, GED, or equivalent

Desired: Bachelor's degree in Economics, Mathematics, Finance, or related field

Preferred experience:

Data analytics or pricing analysis

Ticketing, sports, or entertainment industry

Sales reporting/forecasting

Special Requirements:

Applicant should reside within a 40-mile radius of Pomona, NY 10970.

This is an in-person role.

Job Type: Full-time

Salary: $50,000 – $67,000/year, with room for fast advancement

Benefits: Paid time off

Schedule: Tuesday–Saturday (details above); Sunday & Monday off

Supplemental Pay: Bonus opportunities

Application Questions:

Describe your experience (if any) with sports ticketing, pricing, or data analytics.

Are you comfortable working a fixed Tuesday–Saturday schedule, including Friday evenings (12–8 PM) and Saturdays (8 AM–5 PM), with Sundays and Mondays off?

Have you used AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) for work-related data analysis or reporting? Describe briefly.

How long is your commute to Pomona, NY 10970 by car?

Do you follow professional US sports? Which teams?

If hired, what date are you available to start?

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

At JRM Construction, we build more than exceptional spaces - we build talented teams, rewarding careers, and trusted relationships. As a leading employee-owned construction firm, our people take ownership of every project and work collaboratively to deliver outstanding quality and a positive client experience. Guided by integrity, teamwork, continuous improvement, and genuine care for our people, JRM provides an environment where employees can grow and help shape the company's long-term success.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Cybersecurity Analyst who combines a strong foundation in Windows-based IT administration with hands-on experience designing, implementing, and operating modern information security tools, alongside a governance-focused mindset. This role is critical to the success of our security operations and will play a key part in evaluating, testing, and deploying emerging technologies and new procedures, ensuring JRM remains proactive in an ever-evolving cybersecurity landscape. The ideal candidate is not only technically proficient but also highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain detailed documentation, and uphold structured workflows. The Analyst also shares responsibility for incident response.

Reporting directly to the Manager of Information Security, this position offers an exciting opportunity for a security-minded technologist to thrive within a forward-thinking program that values agility, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

Governance & Risk Management:

* Assist in developing, documenting, and enforcing cybersecurity policies, standards, and control procedures.
* Support alignment with frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
* Maintain the security risk register and perform technical risk assessments and drive remediation to closure.

Windows IT Administration & Hardening:

* Leverage expertise in Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, Group Policy, and PowerShell to engineer, automate, and maintain secure system baselines.
* Work with the IT and infrastructure teams to ensure secure configurations and compliance enforcement across the environment.
* Deploy, configure, and tune endpoint management and compliance controls using modern UEM, MDM, and EDR tools.

Identity Security & Access Management:

* Implement identity governance practices, privileged access controls, phishing resistant MFA, and conditional access policy design across Microsoft Entra ID and other third-party IdPs.
* Automate and improve lifecycle management processes, including secure onboarding and offboarding.

Phishing Defense & Awareness:

* Operate a phishing simulation and security awareness platform, run phishing simulations, and report on campaign effectiveness.
* Triage user-reported phishing attempts and maintain IT communication templates and user education content.

Security Engineering & Tooling:

* Design, deploy, and maintain core security platforms, including EDR, SIEM, email security, and vulnerability management.
* Maintain configuration baselines and documentation for deployed security tools.
* Integrate security tools with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and the broader IT environment to improve visibility and reduce manual effort.
* Run vulnerability scanning, prioritize findings by risk, and coordinate remediation with IT and infrastructure teams.

Detection, Incident Response & Automation:

* Monitor SIEM alerts and dashboards, and tune detections to reduce noise.
* Act as a technical responder in security incidents: triage, investigate, contain, and document root cause and lessons learned.
* Support incident response playbooks and tabletop exercises.
* Automate repetitive security tasks and response workflows using PowerShell, Python, and SOAR or automation platforms.

Innovation & Emerging Technology Evaluation:

* Participate in research, testing, and proof-of-concept (PoC) efforts for new cybersecurity tools, technologies, and frameworks.
* Deploy new technologies and procedures that improve detection, prevention, and governance.
* Provide technical input and analysis for tool evaluations, pilots, and strategic initiatives.

**Qualifications**

Required:

* 3+ years of experience in IT administration, systems engineering, or information security, with a strong focus on Windows environments.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), third-party IDP providers, Intune, and modern endpoint security tools.
* Scripting and automation skills in PowerShell.
* Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and governance models (NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS).
* Analytical, collaborative, and adaptable mindset with strong documentation skills.

Preferred:

* Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, and tuning security tools such as EDR, email security, and vulnerability management platforms, or evaluating emerging and cloud security solutions.
* Exposure to SIEM detection engineering and SOAR or automation platforms.
* Experience in risk assessments, audit preparation, or compliance reporting.
* Familiarity with Python, SQL, or Bash/Shell for automation and security analysis.

**Salary Information**  
To the extent this position is performed in New York City, the annual salary range for this role is $90,000 - $110,000.

**Company Overview**

Protos Security, a subsidiary of Security Services Holdings, is one of the nation’s leading providers of physical security services. Headquartered in Norwalk, Connecticut, Protos delivers security guarding and off-duty law enforcement solutions across the United States, supported by offices throughout the U.S. and international locations in Canada and the United Kingdom.

By combining experienced security professionals, responsive service and purpose-built technology, we provide clients with greater visibility, accountability and control over their security programs. We are raising the standard for how physical security is managed and delivered, helping protect people, property and communities.

**Position Summary**

The Junior Financial Analyst is a member of the Commercial & Sales Finance team, reporting to the Director of Commercial & Sales Finance. The role spans two functions, Commercial Finance and Sales Finance, supporting financial and sales reporting and analysis across Protos’ clients and service lines. Within Commercial Finance, the Junior Financial Analyst will prepare management reporting packages, maintain dashboards, support monthly revenue forecasting, and analyze performance through variance and trend analysis. Within Sales Finance, the role will monitor and report on sales activity, including pipeline, new business opportunities, and client wins and losses, and support opportunity review processes. Across both areas, the role will conduct ad hoc analysis and work closely with Sales, Operations, Accounting, and FP&A to deliver accurate reporting and analysis.

This position is ideal for an analytical, detail-oriented finance professional with 0–2 years of relevant experience who is interested in developing a strong understanding of finance, sales, and business operations, with the goal of providing increasingly meaningful financial and sales insights.

Commercial Finance

* Prepare and maintain recurring biweekly and monthly reports and dashboards to monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) across clients and service lines.

* Support monthly revenue forecasting and reforecasting processes, including data analysis, model updates, forecast submissions, and validation of key inputs and assumptions.
* Perform actual versus forecast, budget, and prior-period variance analysis to identify material changes and key drivers of revenue and gross profit performance and summarize findings for leadership.
* Analyze client and service-line performance, identifying trends in revenue, margin, and business activity, as well as emerging risks and opportunities.

Sales Finance

* Prepare and maintain sales pipeline reporting, including the monthly consolidated pipeline file, tracking new opportunities, client wins and losses, conversion, and sales trends.
* Support sales reporting and analysis, including monthly business review materials and presentations for Sales leadership.
* Support opportunity approval reviews and client credit checks in partnership with Sales, ensuring deals align with pricing and credit guidelines.

Shared Functions

* Identify opportunities to streamline reporting processes, improve data quality, and automate recurring financial and sales analysis.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
* 0–2 years of relevant experience in financial analysis, financial reporting, data analysis, business analytics, or a related discipline.
* Entry-level candidates with relevant internship, co-op, academic, or project experience in Finance, Accounting, or Analytics will be considered.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret financial and operational data and identify key trends, variances, and opportunities.
* Understanding of fundamental financial concepts, including revenue, gross profit, margins, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
* Strong proficiency in Excel (formulas, lookups, pivot tables) and PowerPoint.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly summarize findings for non-finance audiences.
* Ability to leverage AI tools to assist with data analysis and improve efficiency while maintaining data accuracy, and curiosity.
* High level of attention to detail, organization, and accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Desire to learn and develop within a growing Finance organization.

jobs.title: Credit Analyst I
jobs.description:
At OceanFirst Bank, each one of our employees plays an important role in delivering value to our customers and executing daily tasks in accordance with our core values. We recognize that our employees are essential to our success, making OceanFirst a great place to work and do business.
  
**Great benefits include:** employee perks & discount programs, tuition assistance, incentive compensation program, professional development opportunities, and more! Apply today to #BecomeOceanFirst and make an impact in the local community!
  
ABOUT YOUR ROLE
  
Under guidance of the Credit management, perform analysis of commercial loan requests and borrower information including but not limited to financial analysis, operating performance, industry trends and economic conditions to make initial assessment of credit worthiness. Provide analysis detail and written summaries that facilitate and support the assignment of credit risk rating. Document any deviations from the Commercial Loan Policy as appropriate.
  
WHAT YOU WILL DO LIST
  
Under guidance and direction, perform detailed credit analysis of commercial loan requests and borrower information, including financial statements synopsis, management profiles, business and product cycles, cash flow and trends, operating analysis and debt service calculation. Loan relationships generally include single facility companies and basic collateral relationships within more common industries.
  
With direction, conduct preliminary assessment of credit worthiness of borrower; review historical operating performance and research economic and market conditions as they relate to the borrower's company and industry. Research industry specific information from outside sources, which may include industry publications, area libraries, references from other banks, credit agencies, and internet searches and information sites.
  
Perform preliminary analysis of collateral. Assess the quality and source of collateral being pledged. Under guidance of lending staff, apply an appropriate discount factor to determine an estimation of collateral.
  
Perform preliminary analysis of a guarantor's financial position and construct personal net cash flow through investigation of personal financial statements, personal tax returns and credit reporting documentation. Develop an understanding of any contingent liabilities and prepares summary.
  
Assist in the preparation of the initial assessment that summarizes key strengths and risks and includes identification of any deviations from the Bank's Commercial Loan policy.
  
Under guidance of senior commercial lending team, become familiar with alternative structures in order to reduce credit risk.
  
Under guidance and direction recommended a credit risk rating.
  
Assist in preparation of loan package for presentation and/or approval including the preparation of spreads, cash flows and other required attachments.
  
Partner with lending team to conduct thorough annual reviews of current portfolio clients including review of financials, site visits, assessment of general business information and other factors that would be indicators of risk.
  
Ensure that all work is in compliance with applicable laws, regulations and company guidelines as detailed in company policies. Seek guidance from senior credit staff as necessary and appropriate to resolve potential issues.
  
Develop knowledge of Company and department systems, practices, and policies. Actively participate in training programs and opportunities to expand knowledge and analytical abilities.
  
Participate in special projects and performs additional duties as required.
  
Understands compliance with all regulations governing the banking industry, as well as agency guidelines and organization policies.
  
Understands the compliance requirements to ensure files are maintained in accordance with regulations.
  
WHAT WE EXPECT OF YOU
  
Basic knowledge of credit and financial analysis techniques. Understanding of business, finance, accounting, and economic factors affecting credit analysis and issuance of credit.
  
General knowledge of the lending process and ability to interpret the policies & procedures governing commercial credit.
  
Demonstrated written and verbal communication, and listening skills.
  
Demonstrated interpersonal skills, and proven ability to work in a team environment.
  
Strong organizational skills, ability to set priorities in a multi-task environment and meet deadlines.
  
Demonstrated proficiency with MS Office, specific capability in Word and Excel.
  
Ability to maintain the confidentiality of credit and customer information.
  
  
**Requirements:**  
YOUR QUALIFICATIONS
  
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or Economics, or equivalent related work experience.
  
Demonstrated work experience in an office environment; preferably in banking/financial services.
  
  
INTERNAL AND EXTERNAL CONTACTS
  
Internal contact with Lenders and Portfolio Manager.
  
External customer, prospect and referral source contacts.
  
WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
  
Office environment. Ability to operate computer. Ability to communicate in order to exchange simple to complex information with individuals and groups. Ability to travel throughout Bank footprint.
  
**Salary Range:** $48,460.00 - $72,370.00

jobs.title: Registered Client Relationship Analyst
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

  
  

Registered Client Relationship Analysts provide exceptional service to our clients and support Financial Advisor(s) (FAs)/ Private Wealth Advisor(s) (PWAs)/ teams on a daily basis. Through regular interactions with clients, individuals in this role build trusted relationships. Leading with a client first mindset, a successful candidate for this role will have strong interpersonal skills and will be able to assist clients with their everyday needs.

  
  

DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES:

  
  

CLIENT SUPPORT

  
  

Provide service coverage for a FA/PWA/team including:

* Supporting the FA/PWA/team in cultivating and enhancing new and existing client relationships

* Executing money movement transactions at the request of the client and/or FA/PWA/team

* Answering general non-investment related questions concerning client accounts, including relaying stock positions and providing account balances (e.g., funds due and margin debit)

* Enter profile information or pre-fill account documentation on client accounts and/or documents in a clerical capacity at the direction of the client and/or FA/PWA/team

* Educating or enrolling clients in digital tools (e.g. MSOnline, eSign, eAuthorization)

* Onboard and maintain client accounts, including collecting client information and required documentation in a clerical capacity at the direction of the client and/or FA/PWA/team

* Provide existing clients with details around their account information (e.g., investment objectives, risk tolerance)

* Accept or enter unsolicited orders and/or enter solicited orders in a clerical capacity at the direction of the FA/PWA/team

* Assists Financial Advisor(s) / team in delivering against their business plan and client service model

jobs.title: Analyst, Physical (Early Careers)
jobs.description:
**About DESRI**

DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 13 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 85 renewable energy projects in 24 states.

At DESRI, our culture is grounded in rigorous analytics and thoughtful risk-taking, with a strong emphasis on creativity, intellectual curiosity, and continuous improvement. We operate with lean teams that prioritize efficiency and minimize unnecessary bureaucracy, enabling individuals to take ownership and move quickly. We value open, constructive dialogue and believe it leads to better outcomes. Above all, we are driven to go the extra mile and support one another, fostering a collaborative environment built on accountability, integrity, and care.

**About the role**

DESRI seeks talented, intellectually curious, and highly motivated individuals interested in launching their careers in renewable energy and infrastructure. We welcome applications from undergraduate and graduate students approaching graduation who are interested in exploring full-time opportunities across DESRI's Physical teams.

DESRI's Physical teams span Asset Management, Construction, Engineering, Development, Preconstruction, Project Management, and Project Delivery. Together, these teams support the development, design, construction, delivery, and operation of utility-scale solar, battery storage, and wind projects throughout the United States.

Analysts work alongside experienced professionals to evaluate opportunities, solve complex problems, and support projects across various stages of the renewable energy lifecycle. Depending on individual interests, academic background, and business needs, candidates may be considered for opportunities across one or more teams.

This posting is intended to identify emerging talent for potential full-time opportunities rather than recruit for a single team or immediate opening.

**What you'll do**

Responsibilities will vary by team and may include:

* **Asset Management:** Support the operational and commercial management of renewable energy assets through performance analysis, reporting, contract administration, and stakeholder coordination.
* **Construction:** Assist with the execution of projects under construction, including project schedules, budgets, contractor coordination, equipment procurement, and risk management.
* **Engineering:** Contribute to technical analyses, design reviews, and engineering evaluations across electrical, civil, structural, energy storage, and other disciplines.
* **Development:** Support the evaluation and advancement of renewable energy projects, including commercial, technical, permitting, interconnection, land, and environmental considerations.
* **Preconstruction:** Assist with project planning, cost estimation, constructability assessments, scheduling, and contracting strategies.
* **Project Management:** Support cross-functional coordination, planning, analysis, and execution of renewable energy projects across different stages of development and construction.
* **Project Delivery:** Help advance projects from development through financing, construction, and commercial operation by coordinating technical, commercial, legal, financial, and external stakeholder workstreams.

Across these areas, Analysts have opportunities to develop analytical, technical, commercial, and project execution skills while gaining exposure to the renewable energy industry.

**Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed an undergraduate or graduate degree, with a strong preference for candidates graduating in 2027.
* Demonstrated academic and/or professional achievement, intellectual curiosity, and an interest in renewable energy, infrastructure, engineering, construction, or related industries.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and well-developed written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to learn quickly, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively within lean, cross-functional teams.
* A proactive mindset, willingness to take ownership, and enthusiasm for tackling complex challenges.
* Candidates pursuing degrees in engineering, business, finance, economics, environmental studies, construction management, mathematics, or other relevant disciplines are encouraged to apply.
* Prior internship, research, or project experience is valued but not required.
* At DESRI, we consider a wide range of factors to determine your compensation. We rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, location, skills, and experience. The expected annual base salary for this position is $90,000 to $110,000.
* Our compensation and benefits package includes variable compensation in the form of a year-end bonus, guaranteed in the first year of hire, and benefits including medical and prescription drug coverage, 401(k) contribution matching, paid time off, wellness reimbursement, family building benefits, and a charitable gift match program.

*This posting is intended for students approaching graduation who are interested in exploring full-time opportunities with DESRI. Specific team placement, responsibilities, office location, and anticipated start dates will depend on business needs and candidate qualifications.*

new_jobs.title: Security & Network Analyst II
new_jobs.description:
**Security & Network Analyst II**
---------------------------------

Under intermediate supervision, the Security & Network Analyst II supports cybersecurity operations by monitoring security events, identifying potential threats, and assisting with incident response activities. This role supports threat detection and incident response efforts, collaborates with security engineers and analysts to improve security controls, and contributes to threat hunting and detection tuning initiatives. The Security Analyst II applies developing expertise to identify risks, strengthen defenses, and enhance the organization's overall security posture.

**Key Responsibilities & Essential Functions**
----------------------------------------------

* Support security and network operations activities with a focus on threat detection, cyber defense, incident response, and maintaining the security and availability of enterprise systems.
* Monitor, investigate, and resolve alerts from SIEM, EDR/XDR, IDS/IPS, firewall, vulnerability management, identity, cloud security, and network monitoring platforms.
* Analyze logs, endpoint telemetry, authentication records, firewall events, DNS activity, proxy logs, packet captures, and network flow data to identify security threats, operational issues, and performance concerns.
* Investigate and manage assigned tickets, including suspicious activity reports, security alerts, vulnerability findings, VPN issues, access requests, connectivity problems, and service interruptions.
* Conduct incident response activities, including event analysis, scoping, evidence collection, documentation, containment support, escalation, and post-incident follow-up in accordance with established procedures.
* Troubleshoot issues involving DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, firewall policies, VPN connectivity, wireless networks, identity services, endpoints, and application access.
* Evaluate false positives, benign activity, policy violations, operational issues, and security incidents requiring escalation or response.
* Escalate complex technical issues to Security Engineering, Network Engineering, Infrastructure, or application support teams with appropriate documentation, supporting evidence, and impact assessments.
* Assist with identifying recurring issues, monitoring gaps, alert quality concerns, and process improvement opportunities; recommend enhancements to strengthen operational effectiveness and security visibility.
* Support vulnerability management activities by validating findings, assessing exposure, assisting with remediation prioritization, and tracking resolution efforts.
* Assist with firewall rule reviews, VPN troubleshooting, network segmentation validation, access control issues, implementation testing, and post-change monitoring with minimal oversight.
* Collaborate with Security Engineering, Network Engineering, Infrastructure, and application teams to improve security monitoring, detection capabilities, operational procedures, and incident response processes.
* Create and maintain investigation notes, knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, operational procedures, and incident documentation with minimal oversight.
* Provide guidance and knowledge sharing to less experienced analysts and contribute to team training initiatives when needed.
* Participate in security projects, technology implementations, and continuous improvement efforts to enhance cybersecurity and network operations capabilities.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred. A combination of education and experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Three or more years of experience in technology, cybersecurity operations, network operations, infrastructure support, incident response, or a closely related technical role.
* Intermediate knowledge related to SOC, NOC, security operations, network operations, managed security, enterprise infrastructure, or hybrid security/network operations environment preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently on complex tickets, alerts, incidents, and troubleshooting tasks with limited supervision and strong judgment on when to escalate.
* Intermediate Knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, VPNs, firewalls, proxy services, wireless networking, endpoint security, identity and access management, and common enterprise security controls.
* Intermediate experience using several of the following tools preferred: SIEM (e.g., Splunk), EDR/XDR (e.g., Microsoft Defender, Cortex XDR), firewall management platforms (e.g., Palo Alto Panorama/PA firewalls, Cisco firewalls), vulnerability scanners (e.g., Tenable), email/phishing security tools (e.g., PhishER), IDS/IPS, packet capture tools, network monitoring systems, log analysis platforms, ITSM/ticketing systems, and cloud security or infrastructure monitoring tools.
* Experience to analyze endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and application telemetry to identify anomalous activity, unauthorized access, malware behavior, phishing, credential abuse, lateral movement, vulnerability exploitation, or service degradation.
* Ability to perform structured troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across security, network, endpoint, identity, and application layers.
* Experience supporting incident response activities such as alert validation, event correlation, impact assessment, containment coordination, evidence collection, timeline development, and post-incident documentation.
* Experience reviewing or supporting firewall policies, VPN access, network segmentation, remote access technologies, and secure connectivity workflows preferred.
* Understanding of frameworks and models such as NIST NICE, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-53, CIS Controls, MITRE ATT&CK, or similar operational security frameworks preferred.
* Experience supporting hybrid cloud or SaaS environment

**JOB TITLE**: Data Analyst

**REPORTS TO**: Director of Data Strategy & Reporting

**HOURS**: 40 Hours Monday – Friday 9:00a – 5:00p

**FLSA STATUS**: Exempt

**JOB TYPE:** Full-Time

**About Healthix**  
Healthix is the largest public health information exchange (HIE) in New York State, securely connecting thousands of healthcare providers, hospitals, health plans, and community organizations to improve the quality, safety, and efficiency of care. Through the secure exchange of health information, Healthix helps ensure that clinicians, care teams, and public health partners have access to the data they need to make informed decisions and deliver better outcomes for the communities they serve.

As part of our ongoing **organizational transformation**, Healthix is expanding its focus beyond data exchange to making health information more actionable and impactful for healthcare providers, community partners, and public health initiatives. This transformation reflects our commitment to strengthening community partnerships, improving health equity, and supporting innovative approaches that connect healthcare with community-based services.

Through initiatives such as **Healthix Connects**, our internal volunteer and community engagement program, we are deepening our relationships with local organizations and creating opportunities for our team to actively support healthier, safer communities.

Joining Healthix means becoming part of a mission-driven organization that is shaping the future of health information sharing while building stronger connections between healthcare systems and the communities they serve.

**THE ROLE:**  
The Data Analyst provides the foundation for analytics, namely the collection, quality assurance and availability of data. This IT role requires a significant set of technical skills, including a deep knowledge of SQL, SQL database design and multiple programming languages as well as communication skills to understand what data and analysis the healthcare analysts want to gain from Healthix data stores. They are responsible for the maintenance, improvement, cleansing and manipulation of data in the organization’s operational and analytics databases. The Data Analyst works with team members to define and build data pipelines to orchestrate the movement, transformation, validation, and loading of data from the source to the final destination – data stores defined and implemented based on system requirements and data consumer requirements.

Typical tasks performed include working with the data architect on data warehouse design, ensuring data loads quickly, is easily accessible and rapidly comprehensible for analysts/users; extract, transform, and load (ETL) processing; performing thorough testing and validation in order to support the accuracy of data transformations and data verification to ensure correctness and that data is generally reliable for downstream consumption; data bounds checking and database tuning.

The Data Analyst strives to ensure proper data governance and quality for the Data Strategy team and the entire organization. They analyze complex data elements and systems, data flow, dependencies, and relationships to contribute to conceptual physical and logical data models. They work collaboratively within the Data Strategy team, providing support for their data centric needs. The candidate has strong working and conceptual knowledge of database queries multidimensional query and index tuning, monitoring, disaster recovery, backup, automated testing, automated schema migration, and continuous deployment.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Enhance and streamline data and pipeline architecture to improve data flow and collection.
* Partner with software developers, database architects, and data analysts to support data initiatives and ensure reliable data delivery.
* Independently address the data requirements of multiple teams, systems, and products.
* Refine or redesign Healthix’s data architecture to enable next‑generation products and data capabilities.
* Build and maintain scalable data pipelines and reporting solutions to support growing data volumes, performance and complex queries across Databricks, MS SQL Server, and InterSystems HealthShare.
* Work with Data Strategy and Business teams to improve data models and increase data accessibility for business intelligence.
* Implement monitoring processes to safeguard data quality, accuracy, and availability for key stakeholders.
* Develop queries, support reporting needs, and tailor reporting solutions to enable data‑driven decision‑making.
* Develop and execute unit and data validation tests while maintaining accurate documentation, perform data analysis to troubleshoot issues, support feasibility assessments, evaluate health outcomes, and resolve data‑related problems.
* Provide general reporting and project support across the organization.
* Ensure reporting meets standards for reliability, accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
* Support the development, ETL processes, and maintenance of company data assets and data models, design data integrations and data quality frameworks.
* Evaluate open‑source and vendor data‑lineage tools and contribute to long‑term data platform architecture planning across IT and Business teams.
* Assist in developing an integrated data warehouse to provide a comprehensive healthcare dataset.

 **Requirements**

**QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS and COMPETENCIES:**

  

* 5+ years of experience in a Data Analyst role, with a graduate degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Healthcare Informatics, Informatics, Information Systems, or a related field. IBM Certified Data Engineer or Google Certified Professional is preferred.
* Experience with healthcare data, including HL7, CCDAs, MS SQL Server, Databricks, Tableau, InterSystems HealthShare, and Cache databases.
* Advanced SQL knowledge and experience with relational datab
